en.quote: …reduce the number of people killed or injured in road crashes to two-thirds of the 2004 level by 2012.
en.head: Road deaths fell by less than the targeted one-third.
en.body: More than 34,000 people died on Russian roads in 2004, compared with 27,991 in 2012, a fall of about 18%. A reduction by a factor of 1.5 would be about one-third. This card tests only the deaths component; it does not provide a comparable injury series.
